notes.title: Gallery Access update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, this is an extremely small update which should remove some persistent files which allowed early players to access the bonus gallery prior to completing the game. Players who start with the new version should now see a note at the end that they've unlocked access to the bonus gallery, while players who already have access should keep it with the new update. 

To anyone who's already played through the game and didn't get the note that the bonus gallery was unlocked, it's still there to check out if you want to.

Best wishes, and I hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: Launch day patch
notes.content:
Sorry to anyone who played through past the massage scene in the initial launch version, this patch should correct an issue which prevented one of the scene images from displaying correctly.

Thanks to everyone who already downloaded the game, and I hope you enjoy it!
